eqt-ventures._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8): one company rendered under different names across EQT Ventures' surfaces (the eqtgroup.com portfolio pages 2026, the eqtventures.com archive 2017-2025 read through Common Crawl, Form D issuer names) and its renames; and the desk moves of decisions.md D2 (EQT Growth rows). Canonical = the firm's current eqtgroup.com rendering where the company is still listed. Written at kickoff 2026-09-27 (PRO-163) before the first build.
